methodology: A release ledger of flagship, frontier-moving, and frontier-relevant open-weight models. Release dates come from first-party announcements, papers, model cards, or official repositories. Benchmark values are included only with an explicit source, setting, unit, and comparability key; values with different keys are never presented as a head-to-head series.
